name: frdic-pronounce
title: Frdic Pronounce
description: Pronounce French and English text using the frdic TTS API.
author: you

preferences.name: voicename
preferences.title: English Voice
preferences.description: Voice used by the English pronunciation commands

preferences.name: translationEngine
preferences.title: Translation Engine
preferences.description: Optional translation shown as a toast. Choose None to skip translation.

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL API Key
preferences.description: Required only when Translation Engine is DeepL. Free keys usually end with :fx.

commands.name: pronounce
commands.title: French Pronounce (Selected Text)
commands.description: Play pronunciation of the selected text; never reads the clipboard

commands.name: pronounce-clipboard
commands.title: French Pronounce (Clipboard)
commands.description: Play pronunciation of the complete trimmed clipboard text

commands.name: pronounce-english
commands.title: English Pronounce (Selected Text)
commands.description: Play English pronunciation of the selected text

commands.name: pronounce-english-clipboard
commands.title: English Pronounce (Clipboard)
commands.description: Play English pronunciation of the clipboard text

commands.name: toggle-translation
commands.title: Toggle Translation
commands.description: Toggle translation toast on or off at runtime
